pages.text: The Trait Reforger replaces a $(4)chosen trait in place$(0) with a new one drawn from the same tier pool.$(br2)$(bold)Three iron rules:$(0)$(li)Deterministic success — with materials and energy ready it always succeeds, no gambling$(li)Never damages the organ$(li)Excludes traits the organ already carries, so it never rolls a duplicate$(br2)Requirements: the organ must be $(bold)non-native and set$(0), carrying at least 1 trait.$(br2)Rolled a bad trait? This is your only "in-place respec".

$(bold)Cost per reroll:$(0)$(li)Exhausted Crystals: tier × 2 — tier 1/2/3 traits need 2 / 4 / 6 respectively$(li)120,000 life energy$(li)600 ticks (30 seconds)$(br2)$(bold)Note:$(0) the new trait is drawn from the $(bold)same tier pool$(0) — rolling a tier-3 trait out of a tier-2 pool is impossible.$(br2)Carrying several traits? Pick the one that bothers you most: one reroll swaps one trait.

Exhausted Crystals are the $(4)hard currency$(0) of trait reforging.$(br2)$(bold)Where they come from:$(0) they are the common byproduct of the Activated Fractionator and the Life Centrifuge — the whole purification chain is under "$(l:akaishi:life_waste)Waste Neutralization$(/l)".$(br2)Each reroll eats 2-6 of them, so hoard them early: the sooner your waste pipe network is up, the sooner you stop worrying.
Crafting: eight Akaishi Ingots around one Exhausted Crystal.

Suggested order: skim the "Safe" and "Aberrant" trait catalogs before reforging; the Exhausted Crystal line is under "Waste Neutralization"; essence and life energy come from the "Life Purifier" chain.
